title: Lockheed Skunk Works and the UFO topic: Ben Rich, Rob Weiss, and the DeLonge emails

tellings.quote: Ben Rich who's the president of Skunk Works their most secretive division used to call UFOs unfunded opportunities

plain: Ben Rich, president of Skunk Works, the most secretive division of the arms maker Lockheed Martin, used to call UFOs "unfunded opportunities," according to Michels. He ties this to emails from 2016 and 2017 published by WikiLeaks, a site that releases leaked documents, which involve the Skunk Works executive Rob Weiss and the musician Tom DeLonge, who was pushing for UFO disclosure. Michels tells it himself as a sign that the company took the subject seriously.
